scope: Carry the browser-approved Rockstar account subject from one-time Android device authorization into protected Android session storage so device-local recovery and Wallet work can use the authenticated cloud owner identity.
implemented: The one-time device authorization poll response returns the account subject attached to the browser-approved grant.
Android-independent authorization Core rejects a missing, oversized, or control-containing owner subject before saving the token.
Android session store format v2 encrypts and origin/package-binds the owner subject with the opaque bearer token and expiry.
The device API integration suite asserts the returned subject equals the synthetic authenticated test owner.
notVerified: Android Core JVM tests and Android instrumentation were not run because the checkout has no Android Gradle wrapper/platform SDK.
No Android APK, Binder integration, supported-device session storage, or physical-device account link was accepted.
This does not enroll or authenticate an A2A Broker key/device on the server and does not complete Wallet settlement synchronization.
This is not proof of production authentication, carrier activation, production billing, provider execution, or RockstarOS installation.
